four_sides.factual: Reports a father lost to pneumonia and an intrusive image
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows an image that still breaks the author on contact
four_sides.relationship: Offers a near-identical experience

segments.why: Reports an intrusive image that still undoes the author on contact

segments.quote: I am so angry and mad and questioning my life i loved him too much that I was dealing with anticipatory grief even though he was perfectly fine.

four_sides.factual: Reports anger and long-running anticipatory grief
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows anger and grief tangled together
four_sides.relationship: Confesses the state to someone in the same place
four_sides.appeal: Know this is part of it

segments.why: Names anger openly while the grief runs past what can be held

segments.quote: Now he’s gone and I keep imagining how much different my life would have been with him still here and it hasn’t gotten better.

four_sides.factual: Reports repeated imagining of an alternative life and no improvement
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows grief that has not eased with time
four_sides.relationship: Refuses to promise the poster it gets better

segments.why: Reports the imagining running on and no relief arriving

segments.quote: I am so sorry for your loss, your mom looks like a lovely human. Life is too unfair

four_sides.factual: Offers condolence, praises the mother and calls life unfair
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows sympathy carrying indignation
four_sides.relationship: Honours the mother and sides with the poster

segments.why: Offers condolence with a protest at the unfairness attached

segments.quote: I can relate...

four_sides.factual: States the experience is recognisable
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows a matching loss about to be named
four_sides.relationship: Joins the poster in the same grief

segments.why: Opens by claiming shared ground with the mourner

segments.quote: My sister wanted to be a teacher and was 3 years into her education when she died.. She dreamed of eventually having little ones of her own and I was supposed to be Auntie 💔

four_sides.factual: Reports a sister's death and her unrealised plans
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows grief for a future that will not happen
four_sides.relationship: Mirrors the post's grief for an unlived life

segments.why: Names an unlived future as the object of the mourning

segments.quote: You are as beautiful as her.

four_sides.factual: Compares the poster's beauty to the mother's
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows warmth toward a stranger
four_sides.relationship: Links daughter and mother in one line

segments.why: Ties the mourner to the mother through a warm comparison

segments.quote: Live for her. Experience life for her. 🩷

four_sides.factual: Instructs the mourner to live on the mother's behalf
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows a conviction about how to carry a loss
four_sides.relationship: Charges the mourner with a purpose

segments.why: Charges the mourner to live on the dead mother's behalf
